COLLECTIVE AGREEMENT

between

Example Employer Inc. (the "Employer")

and

Sample Workers Union, Local 000 (the "Union")

Effective April 1, 2025 to March 31, 2028

TABLE OF CONTENTS

ARTICLE 1 - PURPOSE .................................... 1
ARTICLE 2 - DEFINITIONS ................................ 2
ARTICLE 3 - HOURS OF WORK .............................. 4
ARTICLE 4 - OVERTIME ................................... 6
ARTICLE 5 - VACATION ................................... 8
ARTICLE 6 - GRIEVANCE PROCEDURE ........................ 10
ARTICLE 7 - ENTIRE AGREEMENT ........................... 12

- 1 -

ARTICLE 1 - PURPOSE

1.01 The purpose of this Agreement is to maintain orderly relations between the Employer and the Employees.

ARTICLE 2 - DEFINITIONS

2.01 In this Agreement:
(a) "Employee" means a person in the bargaining unit;
(b) "Regular Rate" means the hourly wage in Schedule A;
(c) "Working Day" means Monday to Friday, excluding holidays.

ARTICLE 3
HOURS OF WORK

3.01 Normal Hours
The normal work day is seven and one-half (7.5) hours, and the normal work week is thirty-seven and one-half (37.5) hours.

3.02 Rest Periods
Each Employee is entitled to two (2) rest periods of fifteen (15) minutes in each full shift.

3.03 The Employer shall post shift schedules at least fourteen (14) days before they take effect.
The schedule shall show:
1. the start and end time of each shift;
2. the days off for each Employee;
3. any on-call assignments.

- 2 -

ARTICLE 4 - OVERTIME

4.01 Overtime Rate
An Employee who works more than seven and one-half (7.5) hours in a day shall be paid at 150% of the Regular Rate for the first two (2) hours and 200% thereafter.

4.02 Meal Allowance
The Employer shall pay a meal allowance of $15.00 when an Employee works more than two (2) hours of overtime.

4.03 Overtime must be approved in advance by the Employer, except in an emergency.

ARTICLE 5 - VACATION

5.01 Vacation Entitlement
(a) Employees with less than five (5) years of service shall receive three (3) weeks of vacation per year.
(b) Employees with five (5) or more years of service shall receive four (4) weeks of vacation per year.
(i) Vacation pay is 6% of gross earnings for three weeks.
(ii) Vacation pay is 8% of gross earnings for four weeks.

5.02 Vacation requests must be submitted no later than March 1 of each year, and the Employer shall reply within ten (10) Working Days.

ARTICLE 6 - GRIEVANCE PROCEDURE

6.01 Step One
An Employee who has a grievance must present it to the supervisor within twenty-one (21) days of the incident.

6.02 Step Two
If the grievance is not resolved, the Union may refer it in writing to the Employer within fourteen (14) days after the Step One reply. The Employer shall reply in writing within ten (10) days.

ARTICLE 7 - ENTIRE AGREEMENT

This Agreement constitutes the entire agreement between the parties with respect to its subject matter and supersedes all prior agreements, understandings and representations, whether written or oral.
